children: Juniper Green  Energy is a recently listed fast growing renewable energy (RE) independent power producer (IPP) with current installed capacity base of c2GWac. It’s one of the smallest listed pure-play renewable energy players but has aggressive growth plans.

Juniper Green is a renewable independent power producer (IPP)  which develops and operates utility scale renewable energy projects in India and primarily generates revenue through the sale of electricity to various off-takers, including central and State government backed entities.

It has signed contracts (PPAs) which are set to deliver additional capacity of 2.7GWac over next two years. Further, it has won letters of award, which when signed into PPAs can result in additional capacity of 3.7GWac resulting in total portfolio capacity of 8.4GWac.

We value Juniper Green on a FY28 run-rate EBITDA, which is based on already-signed 25-year PPAs which we expect to be executed by end-FY28. We assign an 11.5x EV/EBITDA target multiple, derived from a base valuation of FY28-end capacity at 9x and 50 per cent  probability of maintaining capacity addition run-rate expected over FY26-28.
Adjusting for net debt as of March 2028, we derive an equity value of ₹23,100 crore. We discount it back to September 2026 to arrive at a TP of ₹330.

Downside risks: High leverage with projects financed with an 80-20 debt equity ratio, rise in equipment and borrowing costs, delay in commissioning of contracted capacity, and lower-than-expected generation.

title: Broker’s call: Juniper Green (Buy)
